footer.tagline: Tracker and collaboration system for a private resource community.

home.metaDescription: NextPT is a private resource community built around quality releases, long-term seeding, and member discussion.

guest.eyebrow: A private community for careful collecting and sharing
guest.title: NextPT
guest.description: Resources here are not only downloaded. They are organized, supplemented, and kept alive through seeding. Find what you want, then leave something useful for the next member.

features.title: More than downloading. A place to keep good resources alive.
features.description: A good PT community should make quality easier to judge, context easier to find, and seeding after completion feel worth doing.

catalog.title: Find the right resource faster
catalog.description: Filter by category and keyword, then check descriptions, file trees, size, and activity before downloading.

tracker.title: Older resources still matter
tracker.description: The community encourages long-term seeding and reseeds so useful releases can stay available after the initial rush.

ratio.title: Sharing has feedback
ratio.description: Upload, download, seed time, and bonus history are reflected in the user center, so steady contribution is visible.

forum.title: Discussion around resources
forum.description: When versions, subtitles, reseeds, or usage questions come up, the forum gives members a place to add context.

subtitle.title: Subtitles and notes stay visible
subtitle.description: Browse, download, and report subtitles separately, while descriptions and issue notes stay easier for later members to find.

account.title: A quieter sharing environment
account.description: Clear rules for joining, publishing, downloading, and interaction reduce noise and make the community easier to use long-term.

flow.title: From joining to contributing
flow.description: The everyday path is simple: join the site, find resources, keep seeding, and participate in the community.

invite.title: Join the community
invite.description: Enter through an invite or open registration, learn the rules, then start browsing and saving resources.

discover.title: Find resources
discover.description: Search the catalog, filter categories, and inspect descriptions, file trees, and interactions.

seed.title: Download and seed
seed.description: Connect your torrent client to the tracker, then keep seeding after completion to build contribution.

discuss.title: Join the community
discuss.description: Ask questions, report issues, add subtitles, and take part in forum discussions.

invite.question: Do I need an invite code?
invite.answer: That depends on the current site configuration. If the registration page asks for an invite code, enter one if you have it; otherwise you can submit according to the site rules.

ratio.question: Why does ratio matter?
ratio.answer: Private trackers depend on users continuing to upload and seed. Ratio helps keep resources available and gives users a clear view of their contribution.

passkey.question: Can I share download links with others?
passkey.answer: You should not share personal download links or torrent files outside the site. Private trackers rely on account-based activity, and leaking links can affect your account and sharing data.

forum.question: Can I request resources or report issues?
forum.answer: Yes. The forum is a good place for requests, resource feedback, subtitle notes, and rule discussion. Good feedback helps resources stay useful longer.

cta.title: Ready to enter the community?
cta.description: After creating an account, you can browse resources, save favorites, join discussions, and become part of the sharing cycle from your first download.

member.description: This is your signed-in home for jumping into resources, forums, and your user center.
